page.overview:
Who is Henderson Family?

The Henderson Family comprises the relatives of Gillian Henderson from The Real Jake, the second story of Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird.

Gillian Henderson is Margie's close friend and the mother of three children. She sometimes help out in taking care of Jake.

Dave Henderson is Gillian's husband. He is an accountant and was only mentioned once.

Patty Henderson is Gillian's daughter and one of Jake's friends. She was first mentioned by Jake when talking to Simon about his friends. At some point, Margie took Patty to the arcade to win the smiley-face eraser for her, so Margie can use it for the Simon doll.
